arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: John Eastman argued the tragedy does not create a property interest.
He stated the restraining order did not grant a property right.
Mr. Reichel argued students receive more process than protective order holders.
He claimed the town provides less process than required by precedent.

paragraphs: The case tests whether a state statute creates a federal property interest. The dispute centers on the meaning of the word shall in a protective order.
